Charles the First appears to have been the first English Sovereign who regarded art, not merely as an aid to the splendour of the throne, but for its own sake. 35242-the-awakening-of-spring-a-tragedy-.title: A Tragedy Of Childhood
35242-the-awakening-of-spring-a-tragedy-.creator: Frank Wedekind
35242-the-awakening-of-spring-a-tragedy-.description: A book by Frank Wedekind. nes which surely have profound significance for all occupied in the training of the young. He sets before us a group of school children, lads and lassies just past the age of puberty, and shows logically that death and degradation may be their lot as the outcome of parental reticence. They are not vicious children, but little ones such as we meet every day, imaginative beings living in a world of youthful ideals and speculating about the mysteries which surround them.

arxiv-2409-20146.title: VMAD: Visual-enhanced Multimodal Large Language Model for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2409-20146.creator: Huilin Deng, Hongchen Luo, Wei Zhai, Yang Cao, Yu Kang
arxiv-2409-20146.description: Abstract Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) recognizes and localizes anomalies in previously unseen objects by establishing feature mapping between textual prompts and inspection images, demonstrating excellent research value in flexible industrial manufacturing. However, existing ZSAD methods are limited by closed-world settings, struggling to unseen defects with predefined prompts.

arxiv-2410-19117.title: Tree-Based Search for Sequence Generation in Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-19117.creator: Dylan Wilson, Yu-Wing Tai
arxiv-2410-19117.description: Abstract This project aims to investigate a novel sequence generation method inspired by the AlphaGo paradigm, adapting it for use with large language models (LLMs). The proposed approach involves creating search trees of different possible completions and evaluating these completions based on model confidence.

arxiv-2506-00928.title: Deep Temporal Reasoning in Video Language Models: A Cross-Linguistic Evaluation of Action Duration and Completion through Perfect Times
arxiv-2506-00928.creator: Olga Loginova, Sofía Ortega Loguinova
arxiv-2506-00928.description: Abstract Human perception of events is intrinsically tied to distinguishing between completed (perfect and telic) and ongoing (durative) actions, a process mediated by both linguistic structure and visual cues. In this work, we introduce the Perfect Times dataset, a novel, quadrilingual (English, Italian, Russian, and Japanese) multiple-choice question-answering benchmark designed to assess video-language models (VLMs) on temporal reasoning.

arxiv-2511-03604.title: The first year of LISA Galactic foreground
arxiv-2511-03604.creator: Riccardo Buscicchio, Federico Pozzoli, Daniele Chirico, Alberto Sesana
arxiv-2511-03604.description: Abstract Galactic white-dwarf binaries play a central role in the inference model for the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna. In this manuscript, we employ the bahamas codebase to characterize, in a global-fit fashion, the reconstruction of the Galactic foreground during the first year of observation.

pmc-10672344.title: Anomalous Left Coronary Artery from the Pulmonary Artery: How to Diagnose and Treat
pmc-10672344.creator: Elaina A Blickenstaff, Sean D Smith, Frank Cetta, Heidi M Connolly, David S Majdalany, Miguel Ortega
pmc-10672344.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Anomalous origin of the left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery (ALCAPA) is a rare coronary anomaly that can present in childhood or adulthood with a multitude of symptoms depending on the age of presentation. It should be suspected in infants presenting with heart failure in the setting of left ventricular systolic dysfunction and associated mitral regurgitation from papillary muscle ischemia. Adults with ALCAPA may present with cardiac ischemic symptoms.

pmc-10715955.title: Patient-Prosthesis Mismatch in Pregnancy
pmc-10715955.creator: Allison Akers, Viviana De Assis, Christopher Scoma, Mary Ashley Cain, Daniela R. Crousillat
pmc-10715955.description: A 24-year-old gravida 3 para 1 woman with history of bioprosthetic aortic valve replacement complicated by patient-prosthesis mismatch presented for prenatal care. pmc-11509311.description: Circular economy, clean technologies, and renewable energy are key to climate protection and modern environmental technology. pmc-12572923.title: Nitrogen Scavengers: History, Clinical Considerations and Future Prospects
pmc-12572923.creator: Sven Klassa, Johannes Häberle
pmc-12572923.description: Nitrogen scavengers play a critical role in treating acute and chronic hyperammonemia, especially in urea cycle disorders (UCDs), where impaired ammonia detoxification leads to toxic nitrogen accumulation. These agents complement low‐protein diets and urea cycle intermediates. Sodium benzoate and sodium phenylacetate are the main scavengers, conjugating with glycine and glutamine to form hippurate and phenylacetylglutamine, which are excreted in urine.

pmc-13191477.title: Mitochondrial dysfunction in adipocyte differentiation: implications for obesity and metabolic syndrome intervention
pmc-13191477.creator: Yunwen Xu, Shiqin Xie, Luoyang Han, Liang Xu, Yuqin Zhu
pmc-13191477.description: Mitochondrial dysfunction critically disrupts adipocyte remodeling by impairing the thermogenic browning process essential for combating obesity through the upregulation of uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) and mitochondrial biogenesis. Deficiencies in mitochondrial metabolism, dynamics (including fusion/fission), and autophagy suppress adipocyte plasticity, directly inhibiting UCP1 expression and destabilizing the PPAR-γ/PGC-1α and adenosine 5′-monophosphate (AMP)-activated protein kinase (AMPK)/mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) signaling pathways.
